installd_service:
service installd /system/bin/installd
    class main
    user root
    capabilities CHOWN DAC_OVERRIDE DAC_READ_SEARCH FOWNER FSETID KILL SETGID SETUID SYS_ADMIN
class_start_trigger:
on nonencrypted
    class_start main
    class_start late_start
baseline_vendor_init:
on early-init
    write /dev/kmsg "RMX2072: project vendor early-init"
baseline_vendor_fstab:
system /system ext4 ro,noload wait,logical,first_stage_mount,avb=vbmeta_system,avb_keys=/avb/system.avbpubkey
vendor /vendor ext4 ro,noload wait,logical,first_stage_mount,avb=vbmeta_vendor,avb_keys=/avb/vendor.avbpubkey
observed_blocker: Installer: installd not found; PackageManager: time out waiting for the installer to be ready
inference: Already-mounted scratch volumes bypass mount_all; vendor has no nonencrypted trigger, leaving the GSI main class unstarted. Verify by scoped event on trial 70.
reference_scope: General fs_mgr mount_all event behavior; the bundled GSI rc and saved trial 69 are the device-specific evidence.
new_candidate_changes: Gate nonencrypted on ro.boot.rmx_scratch=1 after boot actions
Set boot marker only for verified isolated data/metadata seeds
Preserve every previously accepted display option during vendor composition
